positive_snippets:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Wonderful Anniversary Stay at Hyatt Residency, Stayed on 23 January 2026 to celebrate our anniversary

We had an absolutely amazing experience at Hyatt Residency! From the moment we arrived, the staff made us feel incredibly welcomed and special. We were greeted with warm smiles and great service right at check-in.

Our room was spotless, spacious, and beautifully appointed with modern decor. The comfortable bed and peaceful atmosphere made our stay super relaxing. We were pleasantly surprised with the anniversary touches — including a small surprise cake, balloons and a handwritten note from the team that made our celebration truly memorable.

The dining experience was excellent. The breakfast buffet had a wide variety of fresh options — from local favorites to international choices — all delicious and thoughtfully presented, and the attentive service made the evening feel extra special.

What stood out the most was the staff’s genuine care. Every interaction felt friendly and professional, whether we asked for recommendations or needed help with directions. They truly made our anniversary stay unforgettable. Specialy thanx for Deepak, Aakash and Aadil.

We highly recommend Hyatt Residency for anyone looking for a comfortable, luxurious, and memorable stay — especially for special occasions like anniversaries. We can’t wait to come back again!

I had a very pleasant stay at Hyatt Regency Gurgaon, Sector 83. The hotel environment is comfortable, well-maintained, and very conducive for rest after a long day. The rooms are clean, spacious, and properly organized, making the stay truly enjoyable.

I would especially like to appreciate the Housekeeping team, particularly Nihsa, who was extremely helpful, attentive, and always friendly. Her positive attitude and willingness to assist made a significant difference during my stay. She consistently ensured that everything in the room was perfectly arranged and comfortable.

Thank you to the entire team for the excellent hospitality. I truly appreciate the professional service and warm support.

Exceptional Stay at Hyatt Regency Gurgaon - 5 Stars 🌟

I had a wonderful stay at Hyatt Regency Sector 83, Gurgaon. The dining experience at Kitchen District was outstanding, thanks to the warm hospitality and attentive staff like Adil and Sahil. Adil's proactive service and Sahil's efforts in resolving the overpayment issue with a smile truly stood out, reflecting the hotel's strong organisational culture.

The breakfast buffet was a treat, thanks to Sajid and his team leader Munendra, who added an extra layer of warmth to the experience. Sajid's smile and attentive service made the breakfast memorable - he ensured everything was just right.

The Club Lounge was a highlight, with bartenders Aryan and Aman providing top-notch service, crafting personalized cocktails and making sure every guest felt at home. Aryan's 6th sense in understanding guests' preferences was impressive!

The rooms were clean, hygienic, and the staff were always willing to help - room service was incredibly prompt, delivering water to my room multiple times before I even finished asking 😊.

What truly stood out was the proactive support from Ashutosh, Assistant Front Office Manager. When I had a last-minute video conferencing requirement from my room, he quickly assessed the situation and provided a solution, insisting I eat something before settling in.

Ashutosh also accommodated my request for a late check-out, providing flexibility when I needed it most, making my overall experience even more seamless."
His calm and helpful approach was a big relief!

Overall, the Hyatt Regency Gurgaon exceeded my expectations with its exceptional service and attention to detail. Highly recommended!
negative_snippets:
The hotel is marked 5 stars and having stayed at Hyatt properties before, this was a disappointing experience based on the price paid. The property needs a revamp and is not worth the price, we can get much better services at this price range.
This is not a five star property for sure, even the Hyatt Dining Club team advised on call that this property isn’t so great when I told them that Hyatt hospitality level has taken a hit while mentioned my stay at this property ( they were trying to ask me to renew my membership on call )

Let’s start with some pros before moving to Cons.

Pros:
1. Room size is bigger and spacious
2. Staff is courteous and nice
3. Room service food is good and delectable
4. It’s at walking distance to eateries and ambience is quiet

Cons:
1. Property and rooms are not maintained well, the size is big but there are grass patches missing in garden and not much focus given to the maintenance, room sofa was sewn at places

2. The TVs need to be upgraded, there are no smart TV and connectivity is outdated. At this price range and for a 5 star that is minimum to be provided

3. Location is a bit out from the city, google map shows multiple pins for the property and you might end up on the back road if not navigated properly.

Overall, the stay was not worth the price range, would recommend to book another hotel if spending this much amount of money. Not worth a 5 star tag for sure !

A humble request. Please don't bother with this Hotel. It is horrible. Not worth the money.  There are several other hotels that give you so much better service for the same price. The rooms in this hotel at dirty and dinghy. the carpet smells. I have stayed are several times. Every time there is a problem either with the room service the rooms the housekeeping laundry. For a breakfast of only fruits and juice they take 1 hour. I ask him to clean my room after 3 days they don't do it for the entire day. When I  come back they realise they forgot to clean the room. I give them the laundry asking the my need at a certain time they don't even bother collecting it. A gentle reminder please don't bother with this hotel.  the staff is average, the food is good but the hospitality and the service they provide is not a five star service. I don't know who is given them this five stars its should be a three star maximum.
I tried to talk to the manager. He cuts the call and doesn't bother calling back. The phone doesn't work, no hot water in peak winters, the shower doesn't have enough pressure. The list goes on. Very Very disappointed.
